run_mirror_descent_iteration: run an iteration of the mirror descent algorithm on a mean-field game with a given learning rate
create_mirror_descent_instance: create a mirror descent instance for a pyspiel game with a custom learning rate and root state
build_projected_policy: build a projected policy that maps state values to action probabilities via softmax projection
evaluate_state_value: evaluate the value of a game state and update the cumulative state value in mirror descent
get_projected_policy: get the projected policy from mirror descent that converts cumulative values into action probabilities
